_note: Live tools/list from /api/_mcp as admin (full allowlist). The claude-merchant-agent integration sees the subset in docs/shopware-mapping.md.

tools.name: merchant-order-summary
tools.title: Order Summary
tools.description: The right tool when the user names ONE order and wants everything about it — customer, line items, payment status, delivery status. Provide either orderNumber (e.g. "10001") or orderId (UUID). Single order only: shopware-entity-search handles multi-order queries. Read-only: it never alters the order; shopware-order-state does that. Returns {success, data: {id, orderNumber, status, amountTotal, customer, lineItems, transactions, deliveries}}.

tools.name: merchant-customer-lookup
tools.title: Customer Lookup
tools.description: Pull up one customer account by email, customer number, or UUID — profile plus order history and lifetime order total. Provide at least one identifier. Single customer only: shopware-entity-search handles requests that span more than one customer. Returns {success, data: {id, email, customerNumber, firstName, lastName, group, orderCount, orderTotalAmount, recentOrders: [...]}}.

tools.name: merchant-product-create
tools.title: Product Create
tools.description: The right tool for adding a brand-new product, article, or item to the catalog. Give it plain values (name, product number, price, tax rate) — it resolves tax rate to tax ID, currency ISO code to currency ID, exact category names to category IDs, and builds the nested price structure. New products only; for a product that is already in the catalog, shopware-entity-upsert is the raw fallback. Defaults to dryRun=true. Returns the generated payload in dryRun mode, or the created product ID on commit.

tools.name: merchant-revenue-report
tools.title: Revenue Report
tools.description: Money totals over a date range — revenue, turnover, total sales, average order value, period-over-period comparison. Provide ISO 8601 dates (e.g. "2025-01-01"). Excludes cancelled orders. Optional groupBy: day (default), week, month. Use page/limit to paginate the timeline buckets. Never a per-product ranking — merchant-bestseller-report does that. Returns {success, data: {period, totalRevenue, orderCount, averageOrderValue, timeline: [{date, revenue}]}, _meta: {page, limit, total}}.

tools.name: merchant-bestseller-report
tools.title: Bestseller Report
tools.description: Ranks individual products by units sold in a date range — best sellers, top performers, which products shifted the most units. Excludes cancelled orders. Provide ISO 8601 dates (e.g. "2025-01-01"). Per-product ranking only, not shop-wide money totals over time — merchant-revenue-report does that. Returns {success, data: {period, bestsellers: [{productId, productNumber, name, totalQuantity, orderCount, totalRevenue}]}}.

tools.name: merchant-storefront-search
tools.title: Storefront Search
tools.description: Customer-facing full-text product discovery and browsing — NOT for looking up a product by its exact productNumber or field value (use shopware-entity-search for that). Returns prices resolved for the sales channel including customer group pricing, tax rules, and product visibility. Use term for full-text search. Use the properties parameter to filter by human-readable property names (e.g. {"Color": "Red", "Size": "42"}) — the tool resolves names to IDs automatically. Pass salesChannelId to select the channel (see shopware://sales-channels); optionally pass customerId for customer-specific pricing.

tools.name: merchant-cart-manage
tools.title: Cart Manage
tools.description: Manage a storefront shopping cart. Actions: "create" (new cart, returns token), "add" (add product by productId), "remove" (remove by lineItemId), "update" (change quantity by lineItemId), "get" (view current cart). Requires salesChannelId (see shopware://sales-channels resource). All actions except "create" require the token returned by "create". Optionally pass customerId for customer-specific pricing. Edits line items only — it never places or converts the cart into an order; merchant-cart-checkout does that.

tools.name: merchant-cart-checkout
tools.title: Cart Checkout
tools.description: Turns a cart into a real order — place the order, complete the purchase, convert cart to order. If you already have a cart token, call this directly; do not re-create the cart. Requires that token plus salesChannelId and a customerId (registered customer). Payment and shipping methods are optional: omit them for the channel defaults, and if you don't already know the method IDs, merchant-checkout-methods will tell you. Defaults to dryRun=true for order preview.

tools.name: merchant-checkout-methods
tools.title: Checkout Methods
tools.description: Which payment methods and delivery options a sales channel offers at checkout — including whether customers can pay by a specific method. Use type "payment" for payment methods only, "shipping" for shipping methods only, or "all" for both. Read-only: it returns method names and IDs, it never places an order — merchant-cart-checkout does that.

tools.name: shopware-media-upload
tools.title: Media Upload
tools.description: Upload any image or file — including product cover images — to Shopware's media library from a URL. url is the only required parameter; productId, fileName, and mediaFolderId are all optional. Call this tool immediately with just the URL whenever the user asks to upload, import, or add an image. Returns the new mediaId.

tools.name: shopware-order-state
tools.title: Order State
tools.description: Change the state of an order, its transactions, and/or its deliveries in one call. Looks up the order by orderNumber or orderId. Provide at least one of orderAction, transactionAction, or deliveryAction. Common actions: cancel, process, complete, reopen, paid, refund, ship, retour. Always use dryRun=true (default) to preview available transitions before executing with dryRun=false. See shopware://state-machines resource for all valid states and transitions.

tools.name: shopware-entity-upsert
tools.title: Entity Upsert
tools.description: Create or update Shopware entity data. Always use dryRun=true (default) first to validate, then set dryRun=false to persist. Use shopware-entity-schema to understand required fields before building the payload. Returns validation result in dryRun mode, or the written entity data on commit.

tools.name: shopware-entity-schema
tools.title: Entity Schema
tools.description: Get the field and association schema of a Shopware entity definition. Use this first to discover field names, types, and associations before building search criteria with shopware-entity-search. Returns {success, data: {fields: [...], associations: [...]}}. See shopware://entities resource for all available entity names.

tools.name: shopware-entity-read
tools.title: Entity Read
tools.description: Read a single Shopware entity by its UUID. Use when you already have an entity ID. For searching by other fields, use shopware-entity-search instead. Returns {success, data: {id, ...fields}, _meta: {}}. Pass criteria JSON to include associations or select fields.

tools.name: shopware-entity-aggregate
tools.title: Entity Aggregate
tools.description: The correct tool for count, sum, average, and other aggregate questions. Use this — not shopware-entity-search — for any 'how many', 'total value', or 'average' query. Note: entity-search's _meta.total is pagination metadata, not a reporting count. Supports: count, avg, sum, min, max, terms, date-histogram. Returns only aggregation results, no entity rows. Pass aggregation definitions as Admin API criteria JSON.

tools.name: shopware-entity-delete
tools.title: Entity Delete
tools.description: Delete Shopware entities by their UUIDs. Always use dryRun=true (default) first to preview cascade effects and dependent entity deletions, then set dryRun=false to execute. Returns {success, data: {deleted, notFound}, _meta: {dryRun}}.

tools.name: shopware-system-config-read
tools.title: System Config Read
tools.description: Read Shopware application configuration values in the core.* namespace. Pass a domain prefix (e.g. "core.listing") to get all keys, or a full dotted key to read a single value. For theme appearance settings (colors, logos, fonts), use shopware-theme-config instead. Optionally scope to a sales channel.

tools.name: shopware-system-config-write
tools.title: System Config Write
tools.description: Modify or overwrite a Shopware system configuration value — use this whenever the user wants to change, set, or update a config key. Provide the full dotted key (e.g. 'core.basicInformation.shopName') and the new value. dryRun=true (default) shows a before/after diff without saving; set dryRun=false to persist. Optionally scope to a sales channel.

tools.name: shopware-entity-search
tools.title: Entity Search
tools.description: Search and filter Shopware entities — use this to look up a product by its productNumber or any exact field value, including as the first step in Storefront cart/checkout workflows. For count/sum/average reporting, use shopware-entity-aggregate instead (the _meta.total here is pagination metadata, not a reporting count). Accepts Admin API criteria JSON. Returns {success, data: [...], _meta: {total, page, limit}}. Use shopware-entity-schema first if you need field names.

tools.name: shopware-theme-config
tools.description: Read or update theme appearance settings (colors, logos, fonts) for a sales channel. Use action "get" to read the current theme config. Use action "update" with a config JSON to change values; dryRun=true (default) previews changes. Pass a salesChannelId to scope to a specific channel (see shopware://sales-channels for IDs).
